description: Every stored family of the AAC store (docs/store.md 2.7): its key, value encoding, producer, retention and authority. Every redb table is derived_rebuildable from the logs.

events.payload: native/aac-store/src/usage.rs SampledBatch {observations: [Sampled]}: every changed account of one sampling tick
events.producer: usage::record (the analytics sampler and the backfill)
events.dedupe: the projector's per-account rule: sampled time never goes back, an unchanged sample is skipped

events.payload: native/aac-store/src/usage.rs SeenBatch {accounts: [Seen]}: every unchanged account of one sampling tick

{day, part, parts, refused_excluded, series[{account, window, hours[{hour, rollup}], day_rollup, periods[{start_ms, period}]}]}; a rollup is a 12-element array (usage.rs rollup_to_json); refused_excluded marks closes computed with refused observations left out; replaces_set_aside marks a replacement close written at open
events.producer: usage::close_days (maintenance, 2 h after a UTC day ends)

events.payload: log::Finding {kind, detail, start_seq, end_seq, refused?: {day, series[fingerprint]}}

tables.name: meta
tables.notes: store_schema_version, instance_id, created_ms, clean_shutdown, closed_through_day, last_*_ms; ts:* keys are the TypeScript side's (backfill markers)

tables.name: idem
tables.notes: reserved for ledger events with idempotency keys (phase 2 onward)

tables.name: series
tables.query: series list; all accounts at time T

tables.name: series_by_provider
tables.key: p u32 | a u32 | w u32

tables.name: reading_day
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | day u32
tables.value: packed spans v1 (src/pack.rs): version, count, then per span the distance from the span before, its length, a changed-field mask and only the changed fields; holds closed spans only
tables.query: an account and window over a time range (one value per day in the range); all series at time T and the oldest reading (a seek per series); pruning (each series' days through the cutoff)
tables.retention: 90 days, by span: a value whose spans all ended before the cutoff goes, one that straddles it is rewritten

tables.name: latest
tables.value: t_first u64 | period_start u64 | binary Row v1: version, flags, presence mask, last_seen u64, then the present f64/i64 fields
tables.query: the latest reading per account; each series' open span, which is only here

tables.name: account_latest
tables.query: account status now; the change decision

tables.name: period
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | t_start u64
tables.retention: kept for good (final periods through usage.day_closed)

tables.name: rollup_hours
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | day u32
tables.value: packed hours v1 (src/pack.rs): version, 24-bit mask of the hours present, then their binary Rollup v2 values
tables.query: burn over any span, hourly charts (one value per day in the range)

tables.name: rollup_day
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | day u32
tables.value: binary Rollup v2: presence mask varint, then the present fields (percentages f32, whole ones as a varint; credits f64, whole or hundredth ones as a varint)

tables.name: finding
tables.notes: disclosed loss and set-aside findings kept across opens; rebuilt from the ledger's store.integrity_detected

tables.name: refused
tables.notes: series and days a refused observation touched; from replay and from store.integrity_detected

tables.name: summary_unmarked
tables.value: a u32 | w u32 | entries (1 | rollup day u64, or 2 | period start u64)
tables.notes: what closed-day summaries applied without refused_excluded wrote, under every day they depend on; withdrawn if a refusal arrives later

tables.name: refused_by_series
tables.notes: refused by series, for the unbounded-reach check

tables.name: summary_unbounded
tables.key: series fingerprint (16 bytes) | last day u32
tables.notes: the same for numbers whose dependence has no bound (unknown window length, no surviving reading); withdrawn by a refusal on any day up to the last

tables.name: reclose
tables.key: day u32 | a u32 | w u32
tables.notes: series-days whose older summary was set aside while clean readings gave the day; a replacement close is appended at open
